verdict.rationale: Docs show explicit Pydantic BaseModel schema extraction (notte-docs-15) and structured-data messaging (notte-docs-3, notte-docs-16), indicating typed extraction is a first-class feature. However, a hands-on community report states extraction from a real site (hyatt.com) 'completely failed' (notte-comm-1), directly contradicting reliability of the extraction pipeline. Missing for 10: independent corroboration of successful schema-validated extraction, and no evidence addressing/reconciling the reported failure.
